original: It's so nice to be on solid\nground!
I didn't think it'd *actually*\ntake five days.
It wouldn't have been unusual for\nit to have taken longer.
Yep, yep, it's all thanks to\nWhamon!
This is a really big island.
It's not an island, it's a\ncontinent!
First time bein' on so much land.
So, where do we go now?
Whamon said there's a Koromon\nvillage in the forest.
I used to be a Koromon.
The Koromon should be willing to\nhelp us.
A Koromon village in the middle of\nthe forest? Lemme take a quick\nlook.
There's a huge gap in the middle\nof the forest. I bet that's the\nvillage.
Well then, that seems to settle\nit.
A bath, a bath, a bath!
She's always off in her own\nworld...
There aren't any Koromon here,\njust a bunch of Pagumon...
Well, we'll just have to talk to\nthem for now!
Hey, I heard there's a Koromon\nvillage around here, but...
So it really is a Pagumon village.
Hey, is he calling me an insect?
Pagumon are said to be nasty\nDigimon.
It's a joke! We're giving you a\nwarm welcome here!
Are there only Pagumon in this\nvillage? Like, say, are there any\nKoromon...?
Koromon? I've never seen any\nDigimon called Koromon!
You've never seen a Koromon, not\neven once?
We came here from File Island...
File Island? More importantly,\nlook how cute we are!
Sorry! I didn't mean it like that.
Heh heh heh! I'm kidding, I'm\nkidding!
We're searching for the Koromon\nvillage, but...
Wah! I've never seen this Digimon\nbefore!
Oh, no. I'm not a Digimon, I'm a\nhuman.
A hu-man? I've never heard of that\nkind of Digimon!
Hey, do you know of any Koromon?
Ah! Taichi! It doesn't look like\nthere are any Koromon here.
Yeah, no matter where you go,\nthere's just Pagumon.
It's weird! I could have sworn I\nsmelled Koromon...
Maybe it used to be a Koromon\nvillage, and the Koromon moved\naway.
But it smells like they were here\nrecently.
Thank you for coming, everyone!\nWe've prepared a feast for you!
Well, let's stay here for the day.
I felt like Otohime when she\narrived at the Dragon Palace!
Takeru, let's do what we can!
Okay, we'll save all the\ninvestigation for tomorrow.
Takeru? Are you going to the\nbathroom?
W-why are you doing this to me?
He came with a bunch of humans!
They couldn't possibly be the\nChosen Children, can they?
I'm gonna report this to Lord\nEtemon. I'll leave the rest to\nyou!
Got it! All you Pagumon have to\nkeep an eye on the humans. Don't\nlet them escape!
Tokomon's gone. We were sleeping\ntogether, but...
Agumon! Do you know anything about\nthis?
I was sleeping so soundly, I\ndidn't even notice.
All right, let's get everyone else\nto look for him!
Tokomon? He went back by himself,\ndidn't he?
No, there's no way he would.
Hey, you were there with us last\nnight! Poyomon evolved!
...Maybe he wasn't even there in\nthe first place?
I'm asking if Tokomon was here.
Doesn't seem like you know\nanything about it.
I *knew* there was something weird\nabout this village!
Guys! There's smoke coming from\nover there!
We need to offer the Chosen\nChildren to Lord Etemon!
Give it up! You're done for!
Yeah! I got captured by the\nPagumon and Gazimon, and Agumon\ncame to save me!
How'd you know we were here?
I secretly set off smoke signals\nby using Baby Flame on some dead\ntrees!
Perfect! The Chosen Children have\ngathered together! Now we have\nthem right where we want them!
Takeru, I'm sorry for making you\nworry...
Don't worry, I'm just glad you're\nsafe!
I can smell Koromon from the back\nof the cave. I bet the Pagumon\ncaptured them!
Then we have to save the Koromon!
You got rid of the Pagumon!\nWe're saved!
Did you break out on your own?\nWhere are the Pagumon?
They ran away and forgot the key\nto our prison!
A few days ago, the Pagumon came\nand took over our village.
Then what were those Digimon from\nbefore?
Those Gazimon were saying that\nthey wanted to take you guys to\nEtemon!
Chosen Children! Can you hear me?
What's that? There's a huge\nDigimon in the sky!
No, that's not the Digimon\nhimself, it's a hologram! It's\njust a three-dimensional image!
You did well in bringing them\nhere, my beloved Gazimon.
I'll make the whole village you're\nstanding in disappear!
Guys! We have to stop him!
I won't let you! Love Serenade!
That song just right sucked out\nall my fightin' power.
It doesn't matter what attacks we\nuse, he's a powerful and\nformidable opponent!
We can't do nothin' at this rate,\nwe have to evolve further!
So that's why Gennai said that we\nneed to get the Tags and Crests!
What do we do? Etemon's outside,\nhe's waiting for us.
If you follow this to the end, you\ncan escape!
Legend says that we can escape\nthrough here if anything happens!
Just like a Koromon, pulling off\nsomething so awesome!
We're at a mountain really,\nreeeeeeeeeeeally far from our\nvillage.
That symbol in the cave must have\nhad a warp function...
A Crest. I got a Crest! Now\nEtemon's nothing to fear!
Why can't we come this way?
Uhhhhh, because I said so! You\ncan't!
Okay, okay.\nWe won't go this way.
Taichi! Where are you going?\nWe still haven't found Tokomon!
I thought he might be outside the\nvillage.
You might be right, but we should\nlook here for a bit longer!
Got it. I'll search this place\nmore thoroughly.
Stop! It's dangerous beyond here!\nThis area is off limits!
Huh? Really? We can't even take a\nlittle peek?
